scope: Executable source Boss Timer.timeout phase-selection component and actual seven-scene threshold bindings; not registered bosses or a production controller.

focused.NativeBossPhases: 9/0; initial8cases0/8; added health-reader case8/1 before reread implementation
focused.compilerBindings: 4/0; child properties cannot overwrite phase root, unresolved defaults/order/scene binding rejected

sourceFacts: Boss starts at source state-1 and elapsed0. Each actual timeout increments elapsed by1 before examining later child phases.
Source child order and inclusive HP/time thresholds are preserved; every eligible later child calls on_state_changed synchronously before the next child.
The health getter can reread actual HP/maxHP after a prior callback; already passed phases never re-enter after healing.
Actual generic bindings: Tyranosaurus0.7/15, Baryonyx0.5/30, Diplodocus0.5/25, Silesaurus0.85/10 then0.5/35, Therizinosaurus0.45/30.

Carnotaurus overrides the timer and requests a phase switch after its current jump has landed. Brachiosaurus invokes its own increasing phase index directly. Both are rejected by the base-phase constructor.
The component consumes actual timeout events; it does not claim source Timer scheduling, pause semantics, frame catch-up or boss attack-clock integration.
interfaces: onTimeout(state,hpFractionOrGetter,changedCallback?)->ordered source phase indices; changed callback observes state.current already updated and source phase binding.
Config.NativeBossPhases keeps audited numeric/source metadata, explicitly productionAdapterImplemented=false.

fullComparison.returnedKnownFailure: EnemiesB9 > lets a Gobbler eat the orbs on the floor and drop them all when killed; known in historical Actor/full runs

limits: Only a source phase component, not BossService/BossBrain replacement or an automatically running Jungle boss.
Actual boss attack profiles, attack animations, spawning attacks, lasers/pivots/feet/jumps and Meca/Mutant profiles remain open.
No new ready flags, playable Jungle, uploads, runtime Asset IDs, Remote/snapshot/Arsenal or Studio acceptance.
